questions.prompt: In a packed-bore spool valve, where are the seals located?
questions.explanation: Stationary in the bore. The course explains: Sliding Spool Packed Spool- minimizes leaks, seals bonded to spool. Packed Bore- seals are stationary while spool moves. Lapped Spool- has no seals between spool and bore and rely on tight tolerances minimize.

questions.prompt: What does air logic use to control pneumatic power circuits?
questions.explanation: Pneumatic control devices. The course explains: Air Logic Applications Air logic uses pneumatic devices to control pneumatic power circuits. Works similar to electrical control circuits. Used in oil industry and food processing.

questions.prompt: Which logic function does a shuttle valve provide?
questions.explanation: OR. The course explains: Shuttle Valves Function A 3-way valve commonly used in air logic circuits. Provides OR logic therefore generate an output when any input is applied Air logic circuits also use shuttle valves to latch in spring off-set

► Air logic circuits also use shuttle
